# Authorize 2: Risk Analysis and Determination (R-2)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | Authorize (R), system level |
| Phases | Engineering and Manufacturing Development (PH-EMD) (primary), Production and Deployment (PH-PD) |
| Depends on | Authorize 1: Authorization Package (R-1) |
| Inputs | Authorization package manifest (ART-PKG), System risk assessment (ART-RA), Organizational risk context (ART-ORG-CONTEXT), Threat information (EXT-THREAT) |
| Outputs | Risk assessment report (ART-RAR), produces; System risk assessment (ART-RA), updates |
| Writes facts | — |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: AODR (PER-AODR) · A: AO (PER-AO) · C: RE (PER-RE), Component CISO (PER-CISO), Privacy (PER-PRIV), SCA (PER-SCA), ISSM (PER-ISSM) · I: PM/SO (PER-PM) · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |
| Persona cards | [AODR (PER-AODR)](../../personas/PER-AODR.md), [AO (PER-AO)](../../personas/PER-AO.md), [RE (PER-RE)](../../personas/PER-RE.md), [Component CISO (PER-CISO)](../../personas/PER-CISO.md), [Privacy (PER-PRIV)](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md), [SCA (PER-SCA)](../../personas/PER-SCA.md), [ISSM (PER-ISSM)](../../personas/PER-ISSM.md) |

Purpose: Analyze the risk from operating the system, using current threat information, and render the AO's risk determination against the organizational risk tolerance.
<!-- END rmf:header -->
<!-- rmf:body authored -->

## Steps

1. **Generate the package first.** Run `uv run rmf package <run>`, which writes
   `package/manifest.yaml` (ART-PKG) from the artifacts on disk. Why: R-2 analyzes the
   package as submitted; ART-PKG is generated, never written by hand (INV-2), and R-1 is
   represented by this command when it is out of scope.
2. **Entry check.** `uv run rmf status <run>` names R-2; A-6 is done and R-1 is done,
   deferred or generated.
3. **Read the inputs** in `## Inputs`: the manifest, the system risk assessment, the
   organizational risk tolerance, the SAR findings and the POA&M.
4. **Interview** PER-SCA, then PER-AODR, then PER-CISO and PER-ISSM, PER-PRIV when an information
   type has `privacy: true`, and PER-RE (`## Interviews`). The SCA explains each finding's
   context and exploitability; the ISSM advises the AO on the technical picture; the SAISO
   (PER-CISO) and the SAOP (PER-PRIV) join the analysis; the risk executive (function) may add
   organizational risk tolerance, dependencies among systems, mission requirements or the risk
   management strategy; the AODR analyzes the risk for the AO and states the risk determination.
5. **Rate each risk.** Group findings that share a threat event into one risk. For each
   risk, rate `likelihood` and `impact` on the SP 800-30 scale (`very-low`, `low`,
   `moderate`, `high`, `very-high`) and derive `level` from SP 800-30 Table I-2:

   | Likelihood \ Impact | very-low | low | moderate | high | very-high |
   |---|---|---|---|---|---|
   | very-high | very-low | low | moderate | high | very-high |
   | high | very-low | low | moderate | high | very-high |
   | moderate | very-low | low | moderate | moderate | high |
   | low | very-low | low | low | low | moderate |
   | very-low | very-low | very-low | very-low | low | low |

   Take likelihood and impact from the threat events in `artifacts/data/ra.yaml`, adjusted by the
   assessment evidence and the mitigations in place. Why: a level that is not derived from
   the table cannot be reproduced by a reviewer.
6. **Write `artifacts/data/rar.yaml`** whole from `templates/data/rar.yaml`:
   - one `RSK-###` record per risk with `title`, `description` (threat, weakness, effect),
     `likelihood`, `impact`, `level`, `finding_refs` (every `FND-###`/`STG-###` behind it),
     `poam_refs` (every `POAM-###` that remediates it), `response` (`accept`, `mitigate`,
     `avoid`, `share`, `transfer`, as the AODR recommends), `residual_level` (the level
     expected once the POA&M mitigations are in place) and `sources`;
   - every open finding appears in at least one risk, and every POA&M item in the risk of
     its finding. Why: RAR-001 checks that linkage both ways.
   - `overall_risk`: the AODR's determination for the system, at least the highest risk
     level unless the AODR explains why combined mitigations lower it;
   - `determination`: `by` (`PER-AO` or `PER-AODR`), `date`, `collaborated_with` (`PER-CISO`, and
     `PER-PRIV` for a system processing PII), `technical_advisor: PER-ISSM`, `rests_on` (`ART-RA`,
     every risk assessment used) and `sources`, plus `risk_executive_input` when PER-RE provided
     anything; R-4 carries that text into the decision. Why: RAR-002 holds who finalized the
     determination and with whom (SP 800-37r2 Task R-2);
   - `controls_by_level`: for each of the five levels, the number of distinct controls of the
     findings linked to risks at that level. Why: SRA-004 recomputes it (CNSSI 1254 RAR
     elements 18 and 19);
   - file-level `sources`.
7. **Update ART-RA.** Rewrite `artifacts/data/ra.yaml` whole: revise the ratings of the threat
   events the assessment confirmed or changed, add the events, vulnerabilities, connections and
   suppliers it found, set `purpose.kind: subsequent`, and keep `prioritization.order` and
   `communication` true (SRA-001 to SRA-003). Then append `R-2` to `touched_by` in
   `artifacts/ART-RA.md` and add a `## Update after assessment (R-2)` section: what changed,
   with the new ratings and their basis, traced. Why: R-2 lists ART-RA as an output; the risk
   assessment is kept current with the assessment results.
8. **Write `artifacts/ART-RAR.md`** from `templates/artifacts/ART-RAR.md`: method, risks
   (narrative for each risk rated moderate or higher), the risk determination with its
   comparison to the organizational risk tolerance, and recommended responses, each traced.
   Note when a risk level needs concurrence beyond the AO under ART-ORG-CONTEXT.
   **Body of evidence.** When a received system's `received_documents` in `artifacts/data/reciprocity.yaml` lack one of
   the SSP, SAR, RAR, POA&M and authorization decision, `body_of_evidence.considered` lists
   every item the DoD CIO reciprocity playbook names, considered or unavailable, and a request
   beyond the package is endorsed by PER-CISO before it is forwarded (RCP-007).

9. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task R-2`,
   until 0 errors.
10. **Journal** a DECISION for the risk determination and a CHECKPOINT.

## Interviews

| Persona | Why | Question focus |
|---|---|---|
| PER-SCA | consulted (C) | context and exploitability of each finding, compensating factors observed, confidence in the evidence |
| PER-AODR | responsible (R); analyzes risk for the AO | likelihood and impact per risk, grouping of findings, recommended response, overall risk and how it compares to the risk tolerance |
| PER-CISO | consulted (C); the SAISO | the organization's view of the risks, and whether it collaborates on the determination |
| PER-ISSM | consulted (C); primary cybersecurity technical advisor to the AO | the technical advice the AO needs on each risk |
| PER-PRIV | consulted (C); the SAOP, when an information type has `privacy: true` | privacy risk in the determination |
| PER-RE | consulted (C) | any additional information: organizational risk tolerance, dependencies among systems, mission requirements, risk management strategy |
| PER-AO (optional) | accountable (A) | the risk determination, if the AO renders it personally |

At least 1 interview; this playbook expects PER-SCA, PER-AODR, PER-CISO, PER-ISSM and PER-RE
interviews.

## Inputs

- `package/manifest.yaml` (ART-PKG; generated in step 1)
- `artifacts/ART-RA.md`, `artifacts/data/ra.yaml`
- `artifacts/ART-ORG-CONTEXT.md` (risk tolerance, concurrence rules)
- `artifacts/sar/results/*.yaml`, `artifacts/data/stig-summary.yaml`
- `artifacts/poam/items.yaml`
- Threat information (EXT-THREAT): the threat events in ART-RA; in a real run, the current
  threat assessment the AODR provides

## Outputs

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/data/rar.yaml` | — | schema `rar` |
| `artifacts/ART-RAR.md` | `artifact_id: ART-RAR`, `produced_by_task: R-2`, `touched_by: [R-2]` | |
| `artifacts/ART-RA.md` | `touched_by: [P-14, R-2]` | updated (updater) |
| `artifacts/data/ra.yaml` | — | schema `ra`, rewritten whole (updater) |

## Facts

R-2 writes no facts.

## Done when

- `rar.yaml` links each risk to its findings and POA&M items, every open finding is in a
  risk, and `overall_risk` is stated.
- ART-RA lists R-2 in `touched_by`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task R-2` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- DECISION: `## <time> · DECISION · task R-2 · by: PER-AODR (simulated, INT-###.A#)` for the
  risk determination.
- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task R-2`, with the number of risks by level.
